objective: Trace real target-model Qwen3.6 MTP verification on two gfx1201 R9700s and determine whether material Q6_K N=2/3/4 work justifies a separately frozen narrow-DP4A candidate.

mtp.verification_width_rule: one sampled token plus d drafts gives target N=1+d; account for N=2,3,4,5

body.prompt: Explain how data reuse improves matrix multiplication performance on a GPU in one concise paragraph.

preflight: both target GPUs idle before each process

allowed: one instrumentation-only build of registered source
bounded counters after all required lanes

lanes.semantic: Instrumentation-only normal-graph server records Q6_K MMVQ logical M/N/K, tensor names/types/shapes, fusion, device, graph capture state, launch geometry, wave count, and epoch timestamp. Single frozen request only.
lanes.profile: Same instrumented server and request under rocprofv3 kernel trace with graphs explicitly disabled. Join semantic records to raw dispatches by device, exact symbol, ordered launch sequence, and request time window; preserve all raw CSV.
lanes.normal_graph: Separate registered server/request HIP API trace proves StreamBeginCapture, StreamEndCapture, GraphInstantiate, and GraphLaunch. Timing from this lane is not used for kernel attribution.
lanes.communication: Report direct P2P/all-reduce symbols separately from verification kernels; never combine overlapping copy and kernel durations.
lanes.resources: Fresh registered mmvq.cu gfx1201 HSACO, AMDHSA notes, and full ISA for every active Q6_K N=2/3/4/5 symbol. Report VGPR, SGPR, LDS, private, spills, wave/workgroup. Counters remain unavailable unless a bounded nonmultiplexed attempt joins exactly.

required: HTTP request completes with 128 predicted tokens or an explicitly reported EOS stop
startup_gate.failure: complete_no_go without substituting draft-simple, ngram, a separate draft model, or another target model

aggregates: N=1/2/3/4/5/other counts, duration, and share by device and combined
required_attribution.join_requirement: 100% of material Q6_K verification dispatches joined without ambiguity

required: real Q6_K N=2/3/4 verification calls on both GPUs
combined N=2/3/4 Q6_K verification >=10% of summed MTP GPU kernel duration
N=2/3/4 Q6_K verification >=5% of each agent's summed MTP GPU kernel duration
current one-wave MMVQ route and its resource/work organization proven
credible narrow-DP4A design distinct from N=1 K2/dot8
selector plan preserves layouts, graph behavior, tensor ownership, numerical order, and does not silently affect ordinary small batches
phase19b_gate.n5_rule: Account for N=5 separately; it remains fallback unless a later task explicitly includes it.

artifacts: raw profiler trace and join audit
counter attempt or explicit unavailable record
